name: World editor on Nox Penumbra
body:
Move the world editor's host from C++ (`apps/world-editor/src/*.cpp`, C++ Penumbra and penumbra-bridge) to Nox, on Nox Penumbra. The UI in `apps/world-editor/src/ui` doesn't change.

Plan: `/mnt/project-files/lantern/nox-penumbra-migration-plan.md` (M4 and M5). This needs two things first: the Penumbra board's `nox-penumbra-for-the-lantern-world-editor` epic (M0, M1) and penumbra-bridge's `drive-nox-penumbra-from-chaos-and-cosmos` epic (M2, M3), both on fearless-hq. The editor quirks Dean saw on 2026-11-05 get fixed after this, in the Nox code.
